description: This file is a Markdown document providing a comprehensive design and technical specification for the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including overview, functional requirements, system interactions, capabilities, state machines, and detailed platform capabilities.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported video modes, pixel formats, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other features of an HDMI output port, including platform-wide support.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the HDCP authentication state of an HDMI connection (e.g., AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, UNKNOWN).

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration of possible HDR output modes such as SDR, HDR10, HLG, Dolby Vision, etc.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the HDMI output port, including supported video modes, pixel formats, and content protection features.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Configures various properties of the HDMI output such as VIC, content type, AFD, HDR mode, etc.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes or activates the HDMI output for transmission.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates or disables the HDMI output.
